text: Thanh Hoa approves $304 million upgrade to National Highway 45

The People's Council of central Thanh Hoa Province has approved a resolution adjusting the investment policy for a project to upgrade National Highway 45, from the boundary with northern Ninh Binh Province to Thanh Hoa's provincial center.

The project's total investment has been increased to a maximum of VND8.073 trillion ($304 million), comprising VND5.5 trillion from central government budget and VND2.573 trillion from the provincial budget.

Spanning approximately 68.35 kilometers, the project is expected to improve transport links between Thanh Hoa's midland and mountainous areas and its provincial centre, while strengthening interprovincial connectivity with Ninh Binh.
Improved traffic capacity could give goods from production facilities and industrial parks better access to major north-south transport routes.
The upgraded infrastructure is also expected to support more effective use of land along the route and attract investment in industry, logistics, tourism and services.
These benefits will depend on project implementation and coordinated connections with surrounding roads.
Construction is scheduled for 2028-2029, with completion, acceptance and commissioning expected in 2030.
